description: Robert Milijas and colleagues at UNIZG-FER describe a survey of a two-storey building on the University of Zagreb Borongaj campus. The collection contains raw LiDAR measurements, photographs and inertial-measurement-unit orientations acquired from an unmanned aerial vehicle. Each LiDAR measurement includes an estimated sensor pose in the global reference frame. These are physical building-geometry observations relevant to constructing a spatial building model; the source does not describe a completed digital twin or energy simulation. The title identifies September 2021, but exact acquisition dates, point spacing and coordinate reference system are not given. Zenodo currently restricts access and lists no public files. Licence, price and file encodings are unknown. A limitation is that access conditions and geometric accuracy cannot be checked from the metadata. No related catalogue record establishes the same building survey, and no point cloud or photograph was obtained.
